define.comment: This version is for the curved_modular_OB version, in which the curved surface of the active silicon is modelled by a series of flat strips, with separate modules on the top and bottom of the stave. The passive material is the same as flat_OB with carbon fiber braces to reproduce the peaks in the material thickness scan. 17 April 2026. Sam Henry 24 June 2026 - update to thickesses and positions of braces

detector.name: SagittaSiBarrel
detector.comment: Layers composed of many arrayed modules

layer.comment: phi0 : Starting phi of first module. phi_tilt : Phi tilt of a module. rc : Radius of the module center. nphi : Number of modules in phi. rphi_dr : The delta radius of every other module. z0 : Z position of first module in phi. nz : Number of modules to place in z. dr : Radial displacement parameter, of every other module.
